class: Fuzzy option matching substitutes a different locality
symptom: A dropdown without the requested town accepted another town sharing part of its name.
root_cause: Portal option selectors bypassed the shared matcher, geographic alias lookup treated a town plus state as the state alone, and locality answers could fall through to word overlap.
why_tests_missed: The existing browser regression failed on the base branch; matching coverage emphasized accepted aliases rather than absent localities.
fix: Match localities before country/state aliases in the shared option matcher, use that matcher for portal choices, and prohibit fuzzy fallback for locality answers.
prevention: Test absent as well as present choices across geographic reference data and every interaction route.
